Market today: Inflation is the bogeyman, and it's back. Higher-than-expected CPI spooked the market, pushing yields up and stocks down, especially tech.
Your holdings: SMCI (-35.98%) and MU (-60.37%) are deep in the red and flagged for attention. PLTU (-25.39%) and SOXL (-75.55%) are also bleeding, amplified by leverage and decay. Remember, margin makes these drops hurt more.
Watch: Keep an eye on MSFT. It's showing strength and has a bullish scanner setup.
Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and the big losers. Inflation is the key risk right now.
plays: Trim SMCI: It's a big loser and needs attention.
Trim MU: Another leveraged ETF deep in the red.
Consider MSFT: Scanner shows ACCUMULATE at 540.86-539.96, stop 538.01.
